records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Hana,

We know getting started can slip. If you want a hand setting up your first project or inviting your team, just reply -- happy to help.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Welcome to Wrenfield -- excited to have River Analytics here. If you get stuck on anything in the first few days, just reply to this email directly and it'll come straight to me.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no milestone, and zero tickets. Two Wrenfield outreach emails ([email:de5b8a37], [email:3a901260]) drew no reply, showing no engagement signal. With 8 days left and nothing started, unaided self-activation looks unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Checking in since River Analytics signed up last week. If it's been a busy stretch, no problem at all. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else about Wrenfield.

Best,
Chidi
